title: Sum Spotter
tags: addition,sums,mental math,multiplication,times tables,number bonds,numbers,math,math game,number puzzle,practice,elementary,grade 1,grade 2,grade 3,grade 4,grade 5
description: Sum Spotter at Pip the frog's pond: look at the numbers on the stones and tap the one that two of the others add up to. Six levels from sums to 10 to sums to 100, times and a mixed level, plus a 60-second Rush and an untimed practice. Every group has exactly one answer, with hints and a gentle nudge when you tap the wrong stone.
notes: Built on the Oomba Kit (the pinned kit 1.1.6 tag plus the dress pack): Oomba.game with controls 'none', a fixed camera and Pip the frog as the hero in the meadow theme, the kit's title (three number stones as the badge), how-to cards (keys how1-how3 in the I18N block), pause screen, settings, results card with stars and points (w.win, which calls BRB.gameOver and submits the score), sounds, font and light/dark look. The picker, the pond, the stones, the sum strip and the hint button are the game's own DOM inside Oomba.ui.root(), colored with kit roles through CSS variables (no color codes). The core idea: a small group of different whole numbers on stones in a pond, and exactly one of them is the sum (or the product) of two OTHER numbers in the group. Levels (SumSpotterCore.LEVELS): Sums to 10 (4 stones), Sums to 20 (4 stones), Sums to 50 (5 stones), Sums to 100 (5 or 6 stones), Times (4 or 5 stones, factors 2 to 10) and Mixed (5 or 6 stones, plus or times, the operation shown in the question), 8 puzzles each. Rush: 60 seconds on the game clock (it stops in the pause screen), the puzzles ramping through the levels, 10 points a find plus a streak bonus. Practice: any level, endless, no clock and no stars. Puzzles are made in the game from a seed, never stored: the answer and its pair first, then other stones added one at a time while the group stays fair; a group is kept only when its numbers are all different, exactly one member is made from two others (for Mixed, by plus OR times, so neither operation gives a second answer) and no member is another one doubled or squared (8 next to 4 could look like 4 + 4). Half the time a stone bigger than the answer is added, so the answer is not always the biggest. The same seed makes the same puzzle everywhere (mulberry32). Hints: the first shows one number of the pair and fills it into the sum strip under the pond (? + ? = ?), the second the other one; both are counted. A wrong tap shakes the stone, marks it with a cross and Pip says no two other numbers make it (always true by construction); after two wrong taps on a puzzle Pip shows the pair. Stars for a level: 3 with at most one wrong tap and no hints, 2 with up to four wrong taps and hints together, else 1. Rush stars: 1 for any find, 2 for 8, 3 for 15. Saved in BRB.storage key 'sum-spotter-v1': the best stars per level and the best Rush. Nothing is ever offered for sale. The pond and the sum always read left to right while the words mirror in Arabic and Hebrew; the stones are buttons with their number, the pond a labelled group, and questions, nudges, hints and finds are announced. Phone first: the pond as big as the screen allows with Pip, the sum and the hint under it in portrait and beside it in landscape. All words in 13 languages (the I18N block). window.__brbTest: state, pick(mode, id, {seed}), picker, tap, hint, skipAnimations, setLeft, core.

es.title: Caza Sumas
es.description: Caza Sumas en el estanque de la rana Pip: mira los números de las piedras y toca el que es la suma de otros dos. Seis niveles, de sumas hasta 10 a sumas hasta 100, multiplicación y una mezcla, más una carrera de 60 segundos y un modo de práctica sin reloj. Cada grupo tiene una sola respuesta, con pistas y ayuda amable si te equivocas.

he.title: צייד הסכומים
